manifest.name: work-charter-dsh
manifest.description: Work Charter 0.9.1 policy and native DSH Team integration

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && tsc -b tsconfig.host.json && node scripts/generate-typert.mjs && tsdown --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE host && tsc -b tsconfig.client.json && tsdown --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE client && node scripts/successor-audit.mjs no...

bundle.text:
# Direct uses base Host services. Enable native Agent Team separately for
# multiple responsibilities; no session-coordinator-dsh runtime is required.
- insert:
    - id: work-charter
      name: work-charter-dsh

readme.text:
[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

WCDP adapts the installed Codex Work Charter **0.9.1** to DeepSeek Harness. It records the outcome, authority, responsibilities, writer, evidence, acceptance and recovery of consequential work. Ordinary stable work needs no Charter ceremony.

The **0.2.0-alpha.1** release line uses contract **2** and logical storage schema **2**, targeting DSH **0.1.7-rc.2** at `477b4f420553e8a52c2fbccc464d7561b239c443`. Distribution is a [GitHub Pre-release](https://github.com/junwei529/work-charter-dsh/releases/tag/v0.2.0-alpha.1); package metadata retains `private: true`, with no npm publication. Publication state and qualification limits live in [STATUS](docs/STATUS.md) and [VERIFICATION](docs/VERIFICATION.md); the normative scope is [SPEC](docs/SPEC.md#successor-design-work-charter-091-and-scdp-retirement).

The successor removes the `session-coordinator-dsh` runtime dependency. Native DSH supplies Team membership, persistent teammates, mailbox delivery and restart. WCDP keeps only Charter-specific contract state, authority/evidence history, writer observations, result/review/disposition semantics, frozen role models and uncertain-handoff stopping.

| Arrangement | Responsibilities | Native scope |
|---|---|---|
| Direct | primary, applicable independent R | primary Session; optional R in its native Team |
| Team | P, E, applicable independent R | P is Lead; flat teammates |
| Phased | O, P, E, applicable independent R | O is Lead; P owns E/R work and acceptance |

Continuity (current-task/durable) is independent of arrangement. Contract approval is independent of active/paused/closed run state. R supplies technical review; primary/P/O owns outcome acceptance. Existing unrelated root Sessions, cross-Team work and multiple worktrees are outside this candidate's scope.

The Host validates WCDP operations; the Client is read-only. WCDP does not lock files, grant permission, attest human approval, or enforce every DSH tool. Native delivery is not model inspection or semantic acceptance.

Use a **fresh isolated profile and paired storage** with the exact DSH packages above, Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, Cordis `4.0.4` and shared UI React `18.3.1`. The default bundle patch mounts only WCDP on the base Host services (Agent, Session, tools, skills, system prompt and storage domain). No SCDP is mounted.

For multiple responsibilities the profile additionally supplies `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-spawn-in-process` with provider name `spawn`, and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team`, all pinned to the same DSH version. The optional native Team tool package may be added by the profile owner; WCDP role provisioning and notice tools call public Team services directly. Do not change an installed profile without installation authority.

Start from the Work Charter Skill and `work_charter_status`; the [packaged Skill](assets/work-charter-dsh.md) documents all five model tools and contract-2 JSON examples. New roles select complete model objects using 0.9.1 source precedence and freeze them before first dispatch. Supported selected parameters are `reasoning_effort` and `max_output_tokens`; unavailable models or unsupported parameters stop rather than silently changing the request. Existing Lead settings remain host-owned.

Keep Session logs and Charter storage together. A WCDP-marked native child stops if its paired Charter record is missing. Unknown sends remain durable stops; reconciliation records exact external native-log evidence and does not resend. Preserve old profiles and data: schema 1 is rejected, not automatically migrated.

Use an existing official `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2` installation and pnpm `11.7.0`. Download the versioned tarball and its SHA-256 sidecar from the Release page, verify the checksum, and choose an unused profile name:

```powershell
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\work-charter-dsh-0.2.0-alpha.1.tgz
dsh --version
dsh --profile wcdp-new --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile wcdp-new add .\work-charter-dsh-0.2.0-alpha.1.tgz --ignore-scripts

This installs the WCDP bundle over base/Web for Direct work; it does not enable native Team automatically. For Team/Phased, supply the native Team composition described above. Do not reuse a legacy WCDP/SCDP store. Repository archival of SCDP does not migrate an existing Charter or replace its old data.

After an authorized dependency installation:

```text
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
pnpm build
pnpm typecheck
pnpm lint

Build emits Node ESM Host, generated read-only Remote, and the DSH lazy-CJS browser factory. Runtime qualification uses keyless deterministic adapters and fresh task-local stores; it does not establish natural-language quality or efficacy. Release qualification additionally installs into a fresh dependency graph, runs the native Host and jsdom Client checks there, and installs the bundle with the official DSH CLI into a fresh Web profile. Host health and authenticated HTTP startup pass. Actual browser UI remains unverified because the available browser tool blocked localhost navigation; jsdom and HTTP checks do not replace it.

The previously published [v0.1.0-alpha.1 release](https://github.com/junwei529/work-charter-dsh/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.1), its DSH/SCDP graph and evidence remain historical, runnable subjects. Their results do not qualify this successor. Legacy audit/source/runtime scripts remain for that historical baseline and are not current package commands.

readme.section: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Work Charter
readme.text:
[English](README.md)

WCDP 把已安装的 Codex Work Charter **0.9.1** 适配到 DSH，记录关键工作的目标、授权、责任、写入者、证据、验收和恢复位置。普通稳定工作无需额外 Charter 仪式。

readme.section: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Work Charter
readme.text: **0.2.0-alpha.1** 版本使用公开合同 **2**、逻辑存储 schema **2**，目标 DSH 为 **0.1.7-rc.2**，精确 commit 为 `477b4f420553e8a52c2fbccc464d7561b239c443`。通过 [GitHub Pre-release](https://github.com/junwei529/work-charter-dsh/releases/tag/v0.2.0-alpha.1) 分发；package 保留 `private: true`，不发布 npm。范围以 [SPEC](docs/SPEC.md#successor-design-work-charter-091-and-scdp-retirement) 为准，实际发布状态见 [STATUS](docs/STATUS.md)，测试结果和限制见 [VERIFICATION](docs/VERIFICATION.md)。

候选版移除了 `session-coordinator-dsh` 运行依赖。DSH 原生 Team 负责成员、持久子角色、消息投递和重启；WCDP 只保留 Charter 专属的合同/授权/证据状态、写入观察、Result Notice、独立审查与验收、角色模型冻结和未知投递停步。

| 安排 | 责任 | 原生范围 |
|---|---|---|
| Direct | primary 和适用的独立 R | primary Session；需要 R 时使用同一原生 Team |
| Team | P/E 和适用的独立 R | P 是 Lead，其他为平级 teammate |
| Phased | O/P/E 和适用的独立 R | O 是 Lead；P 管理 E/R 工作及验收 |

连续性（current-task/durable）与安排分开；合同批准与 active/paused/closed 运行状态分开。R 提供技术审查，primary/P/O 负责接受结果。已有独立根 Session 的合并、跨 Team、多工作树协调不在此版范围内。
Host 校验 WCDP 自身操作，Client 只读。WCDP 不锁文件、不授予权限、不证明人工批准，也不强制约束所有 DSH 工具。原生投递成功不等于模型已阅读或结果已验收。

使用全新的隔离 profile 和成对的 Session 日志/Charter store；保持精确 DSH 版本、Cordis `4.0.4` 和 React `18.3.1` 的单一身份。默认 bundle patch 只挂载 WCDP，Direct 可不加载 Team。

多角色 profile 还需同版本 `dsh-subagent`、`dsh-subagent-spawn-in-process`（provider 为 `spawn`）和 `dsh-experimental-agent-team`。WCDP 通过公开 Team 服务创建已批准角色和投递通知；原生 Team 工具是 profile 的可选能力。不要未经安装授权修改现有 profile。

从 `work_charter_status` 和 [打包 Skill](assets/work-charter-dsh.md) 开始；其中提供五个工具的 JSON 合同。新角色按 0.9.1 的优先级选取完整模型对象，在首次调用前冻结；当前适配支持 `reasoning_effort` 和 `max_output_tokens`，不能支持的参数明确报错，不静默丢弃。现有 Lead 模型由 Host 保持。

缺失配套 Charter 数据时，带 WCDP 标记的子角色停止调用。未知投递禁止盲目重发；只有责任人核对原生日志后才能记录恢复证据，并显式恢复运行。旧 schema 不自动迁移，旧 profile/store 和发布证据保留。

使用已有的官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2` 与 pnpm `11.7.0`。从 Release 页面下载版本 tarball 和 SHA-256 校验文件，核对校验值后选择未使用过的 profile 名称：

```powershell
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\work-charter-dsh-0.2.0-alpha.1.tgz
dsh --version
dsh --profile wcdp-new --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile wcdp-new add .\work-charter-dsh-0.2.0-alpha.1.tgz --ignore-scripts

这条路径在 base/Web 上安装 WCDP bundle，供 Direct 使用，不自动启用 Team。Team/Phased 还需要上文所述原生 Team composition。不要复用旧 WCDP/SCDP store；SCDP 仓库归档也不等于迁移已有 Charter 或替换其数据。

开发验证顺序为 `pnpm build`、`pnpm typecheck`、`pnpm lint`、`pnpm exec vitest run`、`pnpm verify:runtime`、`pnpm verify:client`、`pnpm release:audit`、`pnpm pack:check`。发布验证另建干净依赖图，在其中运行原生 Host 和 jsdom Client 检查，并通过官方 DSH CLI 把 bundle 安装进新 Web profile；Host health 和认证 HTTP 启动检查通过。浏览器工具阻止了 localhost 导航，实际浏览器 UI 仍未验证，jsdom 和 HTTP 不能替代它。无密钥确定性探针也不代表自然语言效果已验证。
旧 [v0.1.0-alpha.1](https://github.com/junwei529/work-charter-dsh/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.1) 及其 DSH/SCDP 图是独立的历史发布对象，原有 PASS 不转移到候选版。旧 audit/source/runtime 脚本只服务其历史基线，不再作为当前 package 命令。
